plan.title: Invite one named vendor to an eRFX RFQ project

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test company.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Configure the project with an RFQ-only stage.
Apply the first available RFQ template.
Add the requested CYLINDER product with quantity 10.
Render and populate the RFQ pricing sheet.
Set the requested delivery location for the line item.
Add only the named vendor to the event participants.
Commit the requested 30-minute schedule starting now.
Confirm the project was successfully published.
Open the published RFQ stage's Participants tab.
Confirm the named vendor is listed and selected for the stage.
Confirm that Vendor A is the only participant.
